from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
for file in ['core/application_engine.py','core/runnable_application_queue.py','core/outcomes.py','core/current_priority_queue.py']:
 lines=(repo/file).read_text().splitlines()
 matches=[(i+1,line.strip()[:180]) for i,line in enumerate(lines) if any(s in line.lower() for s in ('retryable','retry_count','attempt_count','needs_user','duplicate'))]
 print('FILE',file,'RETRY_REFERENCES',matches[:50])
name=subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
print('DIRTY_TREE',name.stdout)
